enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $44,310 for Gartner's "Gartner for IT Leaders" service for the Technology Services Department
enrichment.summary: The Board is formally ratifying (confirming) an agreement with Gartner, Inc. of Stamford, CT, for its "Gartner for IT Leaders" service, which is provided to the Technology Services Department. Spending is capped at $44,310 for July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023, paid from general-purpose funds. The agreement's term began before the Board's August 24, 2022 vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Service Agreement - Gartner, Inc. - Technology Services Department

enrichment.headline: Adds $9,900 and one more year to Be a Mentor's vendor background-screening software contract
enrichment.summary: This amendment extends the agreement with Be a Mentor, Inc. of Hayward, CA, from June 30, 2022 to June 30, 2023, and adds $9,900, raising the spending cap from $19,800 to $29,700. The company hosts the District's Vendor Management System, which handles vendor processing, background screening and clearances, and tracking of ongoing arrest records for up to 120 District vendors. The Board is ratifying (confirming) the change after the new term began on July 1, 2022.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 2, Hosted Software License Agreement - Be A Mentor - Technology Services Department

enrichment.headline: Approves up to $200,000 for Hanna Interpreting phone, video and document translation services
enrichment.summary: The District is hiring Hanna Interpreting Services LLC of Spring Valley, CA, through the Special Education Department to provide on-demand phone interpreting, on-demand video interpreting, document translation, and pre-scheduled interpreting appointments. Spending is capped at $200,000 for August 25, 2022 through August 31, 2023.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 – Hanna Interpreting Services LLC – Special Education Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $49,900 for CyraCom's 24-hour over-the-phone interpretation for Special Education
enrichment.summary: The Board is ratifying (confirming) an agreement with CyraCom International, Inc. of Tucson, AZ, to provide over-the-phone interpretation, available 24 hours a day, in the languages listed in the agreement's Exhibit A. The Special Education Department is using the service, with spending capped at $49,900 for August 25, 2022 through June 30, 2023.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - CyraCom International, Inc. – Special Education Department

enrichment.headline: Accepts $18.7M state grant to run the District's California State Preschool Program in 2022-23
enrichment.summary: The Board is adopting a resolution approving a grant contract with the California Department of Education for $18,714,123 for the California State Preschool Program, run by the Early Childhood Education Department. The grant covers July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023. This is money coming into the District, not spending.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Grant Award – California Department of Education – CSPP-2021 – California State Preschool Program – Early Childhood Education Department

enrichment.headline: Accepts $7,500 state grant for the District's Prekindergarten and Family Literacy Program in 2022-23
enrichment.summary: The Board is adopting a resolution approving a grant contract with the California Department of Education for $7,500 for the California State Prekindergarten and Family Literacy Program, run by the Early Childhood Education Department. The grant covers July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023. This is money coming into the District, not spending.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Grant Award - California Department of Education - CPKS - 2021 - Pre- Kindergarten and Family Literacy Program - Early Childhood Education Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $50,000 for HeyTutor in-person tutoring for special education students at La Escuelita
enrichment.summary: The Board is ratifying (confirming) an agreement with HeyTutor, Inc. of Woodland Hills, CA, to provide high-dosage, in-person tutoring to special education students at La Escuelita Elementary School. The goal is to close unfinished-learning gaps caused by the pandemic. Spending is capped at $50,000 for August 3, 2022 through August 3, 2023, and the term began before the Board's August 24, 2022 vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 – HeyTutor, Inc. – La Escuelita Elementary School - Special Education Department
